# SpikingPointCloudPEFT

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods adapted for spiking neural networks processing 3D point cloud data, such as selective layer freezing or adapter modules. Enables adaptation of large spiking models to new point cloud tasks with minimal computational and memory overhead, crucial for resource-constrained neuromorphic edge deployment.
